answer: The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in basalt, expire in crystal, and velvet lists each expiry. Anyone running 46 aliases thus needs 116 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4025 identities would post 3375 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
